name: OpenSEO
description: SEO research for keywords, backlinks and rankings, with your own DataForSEO key

paths.name: .Wrangler
paths.description: The database with your projects, keywords, rank history, audits and reports. Back it up.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: OpenSEO web app and MCP server, published on host as 6756

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: DATAFORSEO_API_KEY
variables.description: Required. Your DataForSEO key: your DataForSEO login and API password written as login:password, then base64-encoded. No DataForSEO account? Leave CHANGEME and set TREG_API_TOKEN in the app settings instead.

variables.name: AUTH_MODE
variables.description: local_noauth: no sign-in, everyone who can open the page is the admin. This is upstream's Docker mode. Leave it.

variables.name: CLOUDFLARE_INCLUDE_PROCESS_ENV
variables.description: Lets the app read these settings. Leave it.

variables.name: VITE_SHOW_DEVTOOLS
variables.description: Hides the developer tools panel. Leave it.
